scripts.name: Setup Worktree
scripts.command: bun install --frozen-lockfile && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && for env in $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/apps/studio/.env.local $T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT/.env.local; do if [ -f $env ]; then cp $env apps/studio/.env.local; break; fi; done

scripts.name: Dev Server
scripts.command: STUDIO_DEV_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) bun run dev
